View: As of 11 April 2024, Ford Otomotiv Sanayi A.S. / Ford Otosan had S&P preliminary BB-/Positive issuer and proposed-note ratings, versus Fitch BB+/Stable issuer and BB+(EXP)/RR4 proposed-note ratings. The nearest dated quantitative concern is Fitch's EBITDA net leverage sensitivity above 2.0x by 2025: its approximate around-2x forecast establishes proximity, not an exact buffer or breach. S&P's positive migration route is principally sovereign/T&C or sustainably greater foreign earnings, with liquidity, stress-test and current-metric conditions. Romania's hard-currency cash generation is therefore both an upgrade enabler and a downside fault line. Funding execution and EV/capex/dividend discipline can dominate apparent ratio improvement. The two-ordinal-step agency difference must remain visible; it is not an average rating or an action probability.
